messages:
alyssa (PM): Quick sync — proposing 'bridge policy' roadmap for next 6–12mo. TL;DR: we need three isolation tiers (shared, isolated-slice, private), routing policies (latency-first, cost-first, SLA-pinning), and rollout gating (canary → regional → global). Launch criteria: p50/p95 latency SLOs met for 95% of tenants, cross-region failover exercised, performance regressions <5% vs baseline, and automated rollback within 5m. Enterprise ask: deterministic region pinning + contractual failover RTO 5m. Looking for feasibility notes, infra dependencies, and a suggested prioritization. Example policy DSL below — feedback welcome.

sam (Eng): +1. For enforcement layer we'll need routing table changes, policy cache, and an attribution header. Rough estimate: prototype 3 sprints, hardened rollout 6–8 sprints.

cheng (Sr Arch): KV cache coherence across regions is the trickiest part. Propose per-tenant sticky affinity to region + async cold-start priming. Also we should define a downgrade path: if isolation can't be satisfied, route to a compatible model variant.

maria (Product): Customers also want per-tenant burst capacity and predictable billing for it. That affects placement and reserved capacity math — finance needs inputs.

raj (SRE): From ops: add automated canary traffic split + synthetic load tests in CI. Chaos tests for region partitions, and a safe-mode that flips to cost-first routing when errors spike.

infra-bot: deploy-plan created for branch "bridge-policy/proto" — reviewers: @cheng, @sam

alyssa (PM): sample policy (very rough):
```
version: 1
policy_name: enterprise-region-pin
match:
  tenant: "tenant-123"
  request: {latency: "<200ms"}
actions:
  - type: route
    target: region-us-west-2
  - type: fallback
    target: region-us-east-1
    conditions: ["quota_exhausted", "node_unavailable"]
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  steps: ["regional", "global"]
```

cheng (Sr Arch): DSL looks fine. Need to add attributes for model-variant compatibility and quantization profile.

sam (Eng): Agree. Enforcement layer must emit tracing spans: `bridge.route`, `bridge.fallback`, `bridge.decision`. Telemetry hook to populate Console dashboards.

maria (Product): I'll prioritize customer asks into a doc: deterministic pinning, burst billing, RTO guarantees — will rank by revenue + legal reqs.

alyssa (PM): Proposed owners: DSL + spec = @cheng, enforcement + telemetry = @sam, rollout tooling + canary infra = @raj, prioritization & GTM = @maria. If no objections I'll make a RFC.

raj (SRE): fine by me. I'll start a failure-injection job and share scripts.

sam (Eng): can we add an MVP scope: 1) region-pin for enterprise tenants, 2) canary tooling, 3) basic fallback rules. Keep isolation slices for next phase.

alyssa (PM): love that. Meeting to lock scope Wed 11:00 PST. Please bring cost estimates and failure scenarios. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria (Product): I'll gather customer timelines and legal constraints before Wed.

cheng (Sr Arch): I'll draft the RFC and include replication tradeoffs.

infra-bot: calendar invite sent for Wed 11:00 PST — attendees: alyssa, sam, cheng, maria, raj

alyssa (PM): End thread — will post RFC link once drafted.
